Good-ending template (מ:סיום בטוב)

← Back to Reading MAM-parsed-plus

This template marks the unpointed next-to-last verse used in the good-ending recitation tradition. In plus format it appears as a standard template object with tmpl_name and optional tmpl_params.

In practice, it is typically nested inside נוסח in the wikitext_element value of good_ending_plus.

{
  "tmpl_name": "מ:סיום בטוב",
  "tmpl_params": {
    "1": "והיה מדי ... אמר יהוה"
  }
}
